items.html: Now, in order to reconcile these statements, you should know that certainly in all the ten Sefirot there is male and female, only there is a difference in how they exist. The explanation of the matter is that in ZON, in whom is the essence of the death — for in them was the matter of the seven Kings who died — there are therefore aspects of male and female in Partzufim separate from one another. And when you find at times that they are joined, this is only when they are back to back, for then their posteriors are stuck together, and one wall serves them both, and a sawing off at the back is required to separate them.
